'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza–Israel conflict]]
**[[Gaza war|Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Al-Qassam Brigades|Izz ad-Din al-Qassam Brigades]] commander [[Mohammed Deif]] announces the invasion as the start of [[October 7 attacks|Operation Al-Aqsa Flood]]. Israel [[Declaration of war|declares a state of war]] in response and warns Palestinian civilians to leave the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-rockets-airstrikes-tel-aviv-11fb98655c256d54ecb5329284fc37d2 (AP)]
***[[Palestinians|Palestinian]] [[Palestinian political violence|militant group]]s led by [[Hamas]] launch over [[Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel|3,500 rockets]] from the [[Gaza Strip]] into [[Israel]] and execute a surprise [[invasion]] by land, sea and air, breaking through the [[Gaza–Israel barrier]] to attack at least 22 locations in Israel's [[Southern District (Israel)|Southern District]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-october-7-2023/ (Times of Israel)][https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-gaza-hamas-rockets-airstrikes-tel-aviv-11fb98655c256d54ecb5329284fc37d2 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/conflict-between-israel-palestinians-gaza-2023-10-07/ (Reuters)] [https://www.memri.org/reports/hamas-islamic-jihad-lions-den-threaten-lone-wolf-attacks-claim-capture-israeli-soldiers-call (Memri)]
***Targeted [[kibbutz|communities]] include [[Be'eri]], [[Ofakim]], [[Sderot]], [[Kfar Aza]], [[Kerem Shalom]], [[Nirim]], [[Netiv HaAsara]], [[Nir Oz]], [[Nahal Oz (kibbutz)|Nahal Oz]] outpost, [[Holit]], [[Nir Am]], [[Nir Yitzhak]], [[Be'er Sheva]] and Sde Yemen. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-10-07/ty-article-live/israel-under-attack-terrorists-infiltrate-from-gaza-amid-massive-rocket-barrages/0000018b-088b-dae9-adcb-abbff50f0000 (Haaretz)] 
****[[Yonatan Steinberg]], commander of the [[Nahal Brigade|933rd "Nahal" Brigade]], is killed during clashes with Hamas in [[Kerem Shalom]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/commander-of-idfs-nahal-brigade-killed-in-clashes-with-hamas-on-gaza-border/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****Attackers briefly seize control of the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]]'s [[Gaza Division|143rd "Gaza" Division]] [[headquarters]] in [[Re'im]], [[Eshkol Regional Council]], before it is retaken. Several [[Israel|Israeli]] soldiers are captured and taken [[hostage]] to the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-regains-control-of-reim-military-base-from-hamas-terrorists-in-southern-israel/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****[[Battle of Sderot]]: At least twenty [[Israel Police|Israeli police]] officers are killed by Hamas inside the police headquarters of [[Sderot]] after the building is seized. [https://www.jewishpress.com/news/eye-on-palestine/hamas/100-dead-1000-injured-50-kidnapped-as-hamas-invades-southern-israel/2023/10/07/ (Jewish Press)]
****The [[Nova music festival massacre|Re'im music festival massacre]] is reported. Hundreds are injured, and some survivors are taken as [[hostage]]s. [[Atrocity crime|Atrocities]] are reported in other locations: [[Netiv HaAsara attack]], [[Kfar Aza massacre]], [[Holit massacre]], [[Nir Oz massacre]] and the [[Be'eri massacre]] which is discovered after 50 Israeli [[hostage]]s are rescued by IDF forces. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/at-least-100-killed-on-kibbutz-beeri-alone-emergency-group/ (Times of Israel)][https://www.nytimes.com/2023/10/10/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-war-hamas-deaths-killings.html (The New York Times)][https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2023-10-07/ty-article-live/israel-under-attack-terrorists-infiltrate-from-gaza-amid-massive-rocket-barrages/0000018b-088b-dae9-adcb-abbff50f0000 (Haaretz)] 
**** Scores of Israeli and non-Israeli [[civilian]]s are taken [[hostage]] to Gaza. Hamas spokesman [[Abu Obaida (Hamas)|Abu Obaida]] says they are being held in "safe places and resistance tunnels".  [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/israel-palestine-hamas-war-hostage-b2425961.html (''The Independent'')]
***Thousands of Israelis are injured by [[missile]] attacks and shootings, and at least 700 are killed. At least 400 [[Palestinians]] are killed and over 1,600 are injured in the Gaza Strip by [[airstrike]]s launched by the [[Israeli Air Force]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/7/israel-palestine-escalation-live-news-barrage-of-rockets-fired-from-gaza (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/over-100-killed-in-hamas-onslaught-on-southern-israel/ (The Times of Israel)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Herat earthquakes]]
**At least 2,445 people are killed and 9,240 others are injured when two magnitude 6.3 [[list of earthquakes in Afghanistan|earthquakes]] strike [[Herat Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/death-toll-strong-earthquakes-western-afghanistan-rises-320-103807606 (ABC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/afghanistan-earthquake-death-toll-500-red-crescent-2023-10-08/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Sikkim flash floods]]
**The death toll from the severe flooding caused by a [[cloudburst]] in [[Sikkim]], [[India]], increases to 47 people. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/india-flood-sikkim-flash-flooding-deaths-himalaya-glaciers-climate-change/ (CBS News)]
*Thirteen people are killed and seven others are injured in an [[explosion]] at a [[firecracker]] warehouse in [[Attibele]], [[Karnataka]], [[India]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/karnataka/firecracker-godown-gutted-at-attibele-hosur-border/article67392614.ece (''The Hindu'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Malagasy presidential election]]
**Presidential candidate [[Marc Ravalomanana]] is injured by police during a [[political demonstration|demonstration]] prior to the election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/madagascar-presidential-candidate-shows-injury-after-opposition-rally-teargassed-2023-10-07/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ecuadorian security crisis]]
**A seventh individual, linked to the [[Assassination of Fernando Villavicencio|August assassination]] of [[2023 Ecuadorian general election|Ecuadorian presidential candidate]] [[Fernando Villavicencio]], dies in a prison in [[Quito]], following the deaths of six others during [[Prison riot|riots at a prison]] in [[Guayaquil]]. [https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/2122736.html (AFP via RTL)]
*[[Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Venezuela]] issues an [[arrest warrant]] through [[Interpol]] for [[Juan Guaidó]], who is currently in-exile in the [[United States]], citing crimes of [[treason]], usurpation of functions and [[money laundering]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/venezuela-arrest-warrant-issued-for-juan-guaido/a-67013934 (DW)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping]]
**The [[Chinese Communist Party]] expels [[Chinese Football Association]] first vice president [[Du Zhaocai]] for [[Corruption in China|corruption]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/former-chinese-sports-official-expelled-from-communist-party-state-media-fc6c09bc (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Peopling of the Americas]]
**Research into the [[White Sands fossil footprints]] in [[New Mexico]] reveals that [[human settlement]] in [[North America]] may have originated earlier than previously assumed. [https://www.npr.org/2023/10/07/1204031535/fossil-footprints-in-new-mexico-suggest-humans-have-been-here-longer-than-we-tho (NPR)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 Formula One World Championship]]
**In [[auto racing]], [[Red Bull Racing|Red Bull]] driver [[Max Verstappen]] wins his third [[Formula One Drivers' Championship|World Drivers' Championship]] after his teammate [[Sergio Pérez]] [[Did not finish|fails]] to complete the [[Formula One sprint|sprint race]] of the [[2023 Qatar Grand Prix]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/sports/10/09/23/max-verstappen-wins-third-f1-championship-in-qatar (ABS-CBN News)]
